page: Vultr voc-s-1c-8gb-150s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute instance featuring a single dedicated AMD EPYC physical core on the x86_64 architecture running at 2.0 GHz. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory and 150 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The CPU features 32 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 32 MB L3 cache, with hardware support for AVX-512, AES cryptography, and SVM virtualization.

Benchmark data reveals a stark contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities due to the single-vCPU configuration. The instance achieves top-tier single-core CPU performance in stress-ng benchmarks and strong single-threaded compression and decompression speeds. However, multi-core CPU metrics, software compilation, ray tracing, and image processing benchmarks fall into the bottom 10% to 25% tiers. Memory bandwidth for large blocks is average, while database operations and Redis SET throughput remain in the weak tier.

Given its dedicated single-core architecture paired with a relatively high 8.0 GB of RAM, this instance offers a memory-optimized profile for lightweight workloads. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for tasks requiring dedicated CPU execution without multi-threaded overhead, such as single-threaded text processing, basic web serving, or lightweight database hosting. It is not suitable for highly parallelized workloads, heavy compilation, or multi-threaded data processing.
